paper.title: EvoFlow: Evolving Diverse Agentic Workflows On The Fly

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Author-reported, single run: under gpt-4o-mini the evolved population scores higher on held-out test splits than reproduced hand-crafted and automated workflows (avg 82.55 vs AFlow 78.40), and on MATH the four-open-model population reaches 72.90 vs o1-preview 70.20 at 12.4% of o1's cost.
